title: Brown wicker wooden aluminum frame outdoor chair
description: This brown wicker wooden aluminum frame outdoor chair is usually used for the terrace, porch, and garden. It can be combined with different styles of coffee table and parasol.  It is a outdoor chair that has been popularized in the home furnishings market. It is made of high-quality wooden painted aluminum and woven PE twisted rattan. The materials are not only comfortable, but also easy to maintain.
